visual_findings: Official 4F pixels show a straight central slab between shallow projecting end cores, with two long outer edges and a short curved/diagonal continuation toward Yuanzhi. The preview top silhouette respects that relation after the source-to-local-frame Y convention.
Official named image and DSC_0078/0080 show a tall straight slab with flat roof and two end rooftop boxes. Preview front is a clearly simplified 12-row facade, not an invented multi-wing building.

DSC_0083 shows stacked curved window bands and a connector lower than the main tower. The model uses a short solid curved link, ten broad recessed bands and an explicit flat cut toward omitted Yuanzhi, not an entire adjacent building.

Top and oblique previews place both rooftop boxes inside end-core footprints. No unknown rear wing, detached canopy or exposed-basement podium appears; the rectangular 3 mm print base is explained as a print accessory.
Rear oblique and long-rear show a neutral wall and shallow end cores rather than mirrored photographed-front detail. This is explicitly disclosed as omitted unseen facade detail.

Seven full views collectively expose front, rear, both ends and roof. The eighth is a connector detail crop and is labelled as such. All are visually usable and unlabelled with unsupported QA/print success claims.

README, source credits, estimates and parameters consistently state around January 2021, no metric survey/1:N scale, estimated exterior height/rooftop-box depth/connector vertical relation, and ten model bands are not proof of ten actual floors.
README and QA text preserve original floating self-intersection exit 1/20 flags and local rational follow-up limits; printing text clearly says no slicer/G-code or physical print validation.
